searchText: Is there likely to be a Geth release with kiln support and kilnv2 api sometime in the near future? Just updating our infrastructure and I'd rather be able to grab an existing release build if possible rather than have to build geth as part of deployment. Got a couple of teku+besu nodes up and running on kiln nicely. 🙂 Guys. Will EL clients support `debug ` API? That'll take some time. We're slowly upstreaming all necessary changes, but we usually don't use the main repo for anything other than master Yes Thank you. maybe replace 🍵 in channel name with 🔥 🧱 ? good call - done Lighthouse has the latest TTD in `unstable`, FYI
